title: Hero Lens & Mobile Crop Pack for Release Announcement
creator: Priya Raman
description: Create a focused image pack for the upcoming product announcement that emphasizes the new onboarding/quickstart UX changes. This pack should include a set of hero "lens" compositions (wide banner + parallax layers), mobile-cropped screenshots optimized for store/blog embeds, before/after toggle sprites for the core Quickstart flow, and short looping motion assets showcasing micro-interactions. Goal is ready-to-publish assets for the blog post, changelog, and social team with variants for dark mode and four locales (EN/DE/FR/JP).
acceptance_criteria: Hero lens (2560x900) with layered parallax export completed in PNG and WebP, including an optional APNG preview for the blog header.
Mobile-crop set (1080x1920 and 1170x2532 retina) for the three key onboarding steps, aligned to mobile-safe area with copy overlays removed as separate PNGs.
Before/After toggle sprite pack (512x512 tiles) with CSS-ready naming conventions and a small animated GIF and MP4 fallback.
Dark-mode variants for each hero and mobile asset, exported and validated against accessibility contrast guidelines.
Localization: four language overlays exported as separate files; ensure text fits in cropped mobile frames.
Assets uploaded to Drive + Figma file updated with component instances; final approval from PM and Growth recorded in comments.

export_spec: Hero: 2560x900 @2x source, export PNG (lossless) + WebP (quality 80) + APNG preview (loop 3s)
Hero dark: 2560x900 WebP + PNG for fallback
Mobile: 1080x1920 and 1170x2532 (retina) PNGs, copy overlays in separate 1440x300 transparent PNGs
Sprites: 512x512 tiles, atlas metadata CSV, GIF fallback (max 3s, 40fps), MP4 H.264 fallback
Micro-interaction: 720x1280 MP4 H.264 (loop) and WebM VP9, with 3s static poster frame PNG

DES-20111 (style tokens update for dark mode)

design_notes: Tradeoffs: heavy parallax increases file size; prioritized a single parallax layer for the APNG demo and provided full PSD for the marketing team to create heavier variants if needed. Mobile-first constraint: use edge-safe 80px padding and avoid placing localized copy within 240px from top/bottom. Accessibility: dark-mode colors follow tokens from DES-20111; when token updates land, quick rerender expected. Documented naming conventions to avoid downstream confusion.
